decisions.reason: The vacuum thermoforming unit builds directly on the firm's dental equipment and materials know-how, has been shown on its own page for two years, and fits integrated workflows the firm can interpret and refine with its in-house R&D.

The orthopedic shoe last is distant from the firm's established knowledge base, which limits its ability to interpret early results, but it applies the firm's digital manufacturing competence, was only launched in 2024 and is presented on its own page, so management gives it more time to learn before deciding.

The post-curing unit complements the firm's digital and 3D-printing dental workflow and draws on related knowledge it already holds, so it is easy to assimilate and improve, even though it is so far only mentioned on the website.
